snippet.title: Reapercussions - First Gameplay Reveal for this Balatro-like
snippet.description:
Reapercussions is an upcoming indie game where you play as a Reaper collecting souls for Purgatory using the fabled death dice. Here's the first glimpse of gameplay, a full 50+ minute run! 

Coming early 2027

Wishlist on Steam: Coming soon

Check out illi.gg for more info.
